rationale: Retrospective timeline metadata for residential mobility, not an environmental dose or geocoded exposure. Entry and exit dates are interdependent across episodes; the first entry may anchor to birth and later entries to the prior exit. Do not count the 250 fields as separate exposures, derive duration from incomplete dates, or publish participant dates. Geographic linkage is excluded; official release notes warn that t002_psu fields are not comparable to PSU.dta. 2014 special Life History survey; retrospective self-report. The official release note states that no weight is provided. Do not pool into regular-wave weighted pairwise analyses without a separately justified target population and linkage/design plan.
